summary: Tested engagement tracking system for CapyMatch Volleyball Recruiting CRM. All backend API endpoints working correctly. Frontend components rendering as expected based on data availability.

backend_tests.track_open_gif: PASS - Returns 1x1 transparent GIF with correct content-type
backend_tests.track_click_redirect: PASS - Returns 302 redirect to / for unknown IDs
backend_tests.engagement_summary_data: PASS - Returns expected structure (totals, feed, by_school, hot_leads)
backend_tests.school_engagement_data: PASS - Returns expected structure (program_id, total_opens, total_clicks, unique_opens, timeline)

frontend_tests.dashboard_whos_watching: PASS - Component renders with data-testid='whos-watching', shows 0 Email Opens, 0 Link Clicks, 13 Profile Views
frontend_tests.pipeline_board: PASS - Board loads with 12 pipeline cards, no engagement badges (expected - no tracking data)
frontend_tests.journey_page: PASS - Page loads correctly, engagement tracker section not shown (expected - no tracking data for tested school)

critical_code_review_comments: Engagement tracking system is well-implemented with proper auth separation (public tracking pixels, authenticated summary endpoints)
Frontend components correctly handle empty state when no engagement data exists
context_for_next_testing_agent: Engagement tracking system is fully functional. No real email tracking data exists yet since no emails have been sent with tracking enabled. Profile views data exists (13 views) which displays in the Who's Watching section. To test engagement badges on pipeline cards or journey page tracker, emails must be sent through the Gmail integration with tracking enabled.
